evidence_quote: This paper investigates the extent to which energy management is practiced in the context of modular production and whether there is a need for research.
we propose to define a uniform energy data information model which can be included into the MTP.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a concept and requirements for integrating energy management into modular production via an energy data information model extending the Module Type Package (MTP); it discusses monitoring energy consumption and cites ISO 50001 as motivation but does not present, propose, evaluate, or characterise any EnPI/EnB measurement model (no indicator or baseline definition, no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Framework/tool concept without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content; evaluation is only planned.

evidence_quote: The focus of our concept is on the extension of the MTP by energy management functionalities.
To evaluate the future engineering and operation approach a prototypical software and hardware implementation is planned.

stage1.notes: Concept/position paper: argues a need for research and proposes an energy data information model to extend the Module Type Package (MTP) for energy monitoring and load management; only a prototype is planned, no empirical case. paper_type is borderline between 'tool/software design' and 'other'; chose tool/software design as the proposed artefact is an information model plus a planned software/hardware system. No EnPI/EnB model -> ineligible; stage2/stage3 null.
